positioning.basis: The KNF register is a DataTables POST to `rss.knf.gov.pl/RssOuterView/JSCRIPT`, which answers 302 without a cookie and 403 with one, on every attempt and with browser headers. This is a HARD failure, not the intermittent kind: on the same sweep `www.gpw.pl` and `espi.pap.pl` each scored 0 of 8 while `emarketstorage.com` scored 7 of 8. So a Polish name has NO positioning anchor.

expected_move.basis: the larger of (a) the median of this name's prior reactions and (b) a one-session move implied by 20-day realised volatility. It is NOT an option-implied move: nothing is paying for it and it carries no information about what the market expects from THIS print. It is a scale for how far this name travels. Phase 1 median realised move was 2.81% (UK), 3.12% (DE), 4.19% (FR) against Japan's 2.87%, with the tail intact in all three -- 42%, 27% and 52% maxima and no price limit to truncate them.

baseline.priced_lean_basis: Sum of the components above. anchor_coverage.basis: `anchor_covered` is true only where the national short register returned a disclosed net short position for THIS issuer. already_public.what: Report date: the Q3 2026 consolidated report is set for 20 November 2026 (RB 1/2026). RB 28/2026 moved only the H1 date, to 28 Sep 2026, because of a new auditor, and said the other dates are unchanged.
H1 2026 consolidated figures: revenue 465.9m PLN (H1 2025: 355.5m), EBIT 58.2m (47.6m), net profit 43.1m (36.8m), operating cash flow +9.2m (-126.1m). Published 2026-09-28 at 20:15.
The CEO said in public that Q3 Secure IT was better than last year, Retail was about the same, the 2026 plan is confirmed, and H1 EBITDA of over 83m is more than half the 150m plan.

Strategy 'Comp 2028 Security First': EBITDA 150m (2026), 165m (2027), 180m (2028); shareholder transfer of 70m in 2026, rising to 91m in 2028. After the SAFE contracts the company said 2027/28 targets may be exceeded by at least 10%, and that any update would be made gradually.
Enigma took a 100m PLN revolver (falling to 50m from 31 May 2027) and a 100m PLN advance-payment guarantee line from PKO BP to fund the SAFE contracts.
An EGM is called for 4 Dec 2026 to raise the upper price limit of the buyback authorisation, because the share price has exceeded it.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 2026 revenue and EBIT above Q3 2025 (revenue about 190.0m, EBIT about 14.7m, computed as 9M 2025 less H1 2025). The CEO pre-signalled Secure up and Retail flat, so a modest y/y increase is expected and largely telegraphed.

Most likely the 2026 targets are reiterated with no number change. There is a low-probability (about 20%) upward revision of the 2027/28 EBITDA and transfer targets by at least 10%. The company said it would update gradually as milestones land; financing landed on 2026-10-07 and the client's option exercise is still pending. Positive if it comes.

Q3 operating cash flow could be weaker than Q3 2025 (about +19.8m) because of working capital spent on SAFE components ahead of 2027 deliveries, and net debt could rise against the new PKO line. Mildly negative optics.
SAFE backlog and option status may be updated. Buyback tranche 2 is usually in December and is gated by the 4 Dec EGM, so it is unlikely in this window.

evidence.text: The CMS CY2027 OPPS final rule (CMS-1850-FC, released 2026-11-04, addenda updated 2026-11-10) keeps CPT 97008 (pre-cooling) separately payable, SI 'S', APC 1494, $35.50, exactly as proposed, with 97007 unchanged at APC 1516 $1,450.50. Paxman has issued no press release on it (in Nov 2025 it issued four), so the release will be the company's first comment.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-07-16 proposal (unpackaging) day closed -2.3%. On 2025-11-24, when the CY2026 final rule was unchanged and the CEO called it 'disappointing', the stock fell 8.5% around that date (baseline history).
evidence.why_not_priced: The proposal has been public since July, so the content is mostly priced. What is unpriced is the company's framing: if the rule had been read as a negative the stock would have reacted around Nov 4-10, and it drifted 63.2 to 62.0 on modest volume. The CEO said in July the rates 'still fall short', so the release may call the final rule disappointing again.
evidence.independence: Paxman's own 2026-07-16 release on the proposal gives the same SI/APC/rate: https://mfn.se/a/paxman/cms-proposes-important-medicare-payment-policy-change-for-mechanical-scalp-cooling

evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY2025 carried 15.1 MSEK of FX losses in H1 that hit net result. The stock fell 3.3% on that year-end report (2025-02-21) and 5.0% on Q1 2025 (2025-05-16), when SEK strengthened.
